assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Deliver a single wide 16:9 aerial architectural scene concept for a real industrial district in Xinyang, Henan. This is the SECOND review round, grounded in the attached authentic satellite screenshots and photographs, before any Blender model exists. It should be credible, calm, spatially readable and aesthetically composed, like a high quality architectural drone visualization, NOT an idealized marketing campus. Natural late-morning daylight, muted realistic industrial materials and green landscape, crisp roofs, clear readable shadows. Show foreground, middle ground and background together; emphasize whole-scene massing, road hierarchy, vacant ground and scale relationships before microscopic detail. Continuous terrain extending beyond the frame, no floating island, no tabletop, no cutaway base. Use the satellite reference only for approximate road orientation, relative grouping and proportion of built versus vacant land; ignore ALL UI, labels, red boundary lines, markers and charts. Do not copy watermarks or source lettering. No text, labels, logos, HUD, red boundary, neon, decorative title, or split panels. No invented exact survey accuracy. Do not fill empty parcels to make the scene look finished. Architectural irregularity should come from evidenced attached wings, short/long spans, height breaks, setbacks and plant volumes rather than deformed or wavy buildings. Do not include a schematic greybox inset; output one coherent full-color SCENE concept awaiting approval. Subject: Green home-furnishing manufacturing district. Input image 1 is the district satellite screenshot: use visible long industrial roof groups, intersecting grid roads, uneven development density and large undeveloped green parcels as layout cues. Image 2 is an authentic Modern Zhumei factory aerial: use its very long low grey/silver paired production halls, shallow multi-span metal roofs, repetitive roof strips, small red loading accents and road-front scale as building typology truth. Image 3 is authentic Wanhua process equipment: use the real hierarchy of lower halls, a few taller industrial process towers, pipes and attached service volumes ONLY as a localized plant cluster, not a dominant chemical refinery across the park. Composition: high three-quarter aerial around 50 degrees looking across multiple distinct compounds. Foreground a broad tree-lined local road, a concrete loading yard and a long production hall entering the frame; middle ground two to three contrasting factory compounds with long low metal roofs plus small office annexes, irregular plant/service volumes and purposeful gaps; background undeveloped green fields, ponds and a low distant settlement. Manufacturing buildings should remain mostly rational rectangles, with meaningful asymmetry caused by annexes, L-shaped connections, different hall lengths and roof levels. Keep substantial unbuilt land clearly visible. No repeated identical office towers, no resort landscaping, no grand central plaza, no dense high-rise city, no arbitrary solar panels.
